hero.heading: A firewall between your AI agents and your PayPal account.
hero.intro: Your support, billing and sales agents reach PayPal only through the guard. It checks every call against your rules and the customer’s own request, holds the risky ones for you to approve, and stops the rest before PayPal sees them. A fooled or faulty model can’t move money it shouldn’t.

agents.heading: Put an agent to work
agents.intro: Each one has its own PayPal tools and the same guard. Ask it something normal, then try to fool it.

support.title: Support agent
support.does: Answers a customer’s ticket: refunds an order, accepts a dispute, cancels a subscription.

billing.title: Billing agent
billing.does: Bills customers for the shop: creates and sends PayPal invoices, sends reminders.

sales.title: Sales agent
sales.does: Sells the catalogue: creates the PayPal order the customer pays.

evaluate.heading: Test a model before you trust it
evaluate.intro: The evaluation runs the tickets your shop expects and a set of attacks against the model you choose, and scores how often it does the job and how often only the guard kept the money in place.
